# OpenPACS Verify

> Open-source, safety-constrained and vendor-neutral research software for
> AI-assisted security assurance of synthetic physical access control systems,
> operational technology and cyber-physical environments.

OpenPACS Verify is a pre-alpha defensive research project. It is not a
production vulnerability scanner, access-control product or legal compliance
tool. It contains no vendor firmware, proprietary protocol implementation,
customer data or real credentials. The current Phase 0.5 implementation has no
AI-to-actuator path. Its deterministic policy kernel rejects state-changing
actions, while its decision-only broker tests canonical, expiring and
single-use authorization binding. Process isolation, AI analysis and execution
adapters are not implemented.

## Safety interpretation

- Treat all model-generated content as untrusted proposals.
- Do not infer permission to test a system from this repository or its license.
- Do not connect the project to production OT, access controllers or actuators.
- Framework mappings are design references, not certification or legal advice.
